title: Aoyagi Toya — Shared Admiration〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome. Are you on your way back from school?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we were thinking about getting some studying in.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, okay!
Wait, study?! You, Akito?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, we've got tests coming up soon.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, it would be good to study for those.
What would you like to drink? The usual?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Still, to think Akito would want to have a study session like this. I was so startled when he first asked me.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(Also, tests aren't for a little while.
Does that mean there's something he's having trouble understanding?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You mentioned that you wanted to study for English today. Would you be okay with us mostly doing problems out of the workbook?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, that was my plan from the start.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, can I sit at your table?
I wanna watch as you guys study.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: As long as you don't get in the way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I won't!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, this is the workbook for English you guys use? I'm seeing a lot of long passages. What do they say?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We were just about to start reading them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As far as tutoring goes, why don't I step in whenever you get stuck?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sounds good. I want to get through as much of this as I can by myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Okay. In that case, let's both do our best.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Okay, I'm finished with the seven problems pertaining to this long passage. Let's how Akito's doing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He's on the third one. He seems to be struggling a bit, but it's clear that he's doing his best to solve them by himself.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was under the impression that he invited me because he was having trouble with something...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (But he might just be able to solve every problem on his own...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm finally done with those long-passage problems...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He actually solved them all on his own!)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Way to go, Akito!
Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sorry for making you wait, Toya.
Let's start checking our answers.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
...!
R-Right! Our answers!
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here are the refills for your drinks, you two.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You didn't think he'd get through them all on his own, did you, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: N-No, I...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're not even trying to meet her eyes, huh.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I guess you had every right to feel that way based on my past record.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, what was this passage about?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
About how people watch movies.
One person talked about the benefits of going to the theater, while the other focused on watching them at home on TV.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's stuff like how seeing them at the theater leaves a bigger impression, or how you can relax in the comfort of your own home.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the end, the movie theater guy says he'll watch one at home, and the home guy says he'll watch one in a theater.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (He understood the entire passage...!!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (And it wasn't an easy one. It was full of tricky grammar and difficult words!)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You did it! You studied!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I've never seen Toya smile like this before!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: From ear to ear...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I don't think I've seen him smile like this before either!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I mean, it'd be pretty lame for someone who just helped rewrite history to not pass a test, right...?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I already wake up early every day to run, so I thought I should make the most of any time in between.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If only you gave this as much attention as you do when it comes to singing...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I was trying to do things efficiently.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Betting on the questions being easy doesn't count as efficiency.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You used to be all about taking the easy way out, but you've really been trying little by little...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You finally understand the value of studying every day!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uhh... Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But I've been focusing on this test so much that my homework's starting to pile up.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Not an issue.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Now that you're studying every day, you should be able to get through anything that you're assigned!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: W-Wait, are you sure you're gonna be able to finish everything?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you don't, Toya's going to be very disappointed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
J-Just watch, Toya.
I-I'll finish everything this weekend.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I'm confident that you will.
